tool_description: Compute the overall heat transfer coefficient for series thermal resistances (flat-wall model): total resistance R_total = Σ R_i (K/W), thermal conductance G = 1/R_total (W/K), area-based coefficient U = 1/(R_total·A) (W/(m²·K)), and if a temperature difference is given the heat flow rate Q = ΔT/R_total (W). Each R_i is a layer resistance already containing the area factor (e.g. convection R_conv=1/(h·A), conduction R_cond=d/(k·A), fouling R_foul=R_f''/A). Enter one resistance (K/W) per line, at least one, all positive. ΔT may be negative (reverse heat flow); a °C difference equals a K difference, a °F difference is converted by ×5/9.
